name: Majestic Hotel & Spa Barcelona
insider_take: This historic palace turned luxury hotel sits on Barcelona's most prestigious boulevard, where Gaudí's architectural masterpieces and high-end shopping create an unmatched cultural tapestry.
whats_special: The Majestic occupies a beautifully restored 1918 building on Passeig de Gràcia, just steps from Casa Batlló and Casa Milà. Its rooftop terrace offers stunning views of Sagrada Família, while the ground-floor Dolce Vitae restaurant spills onto one of Europe's most elegant shopping streets.
pro_tip: Book a Gaudí-view room on upper floors for direct sightlines to Casa Batlló's colorful facade - you can watch the building's mosaic tiles change color with the light throughout the day.
dont_miss: The hotel's La Dolce Vitae rooftop bar at sunset, and take advantage of being within a 3-minute walk of both Casa Batlló and Casa Milà - you can visit Gaudí's masterpieces before the crowds arrive each morning.
pros: Prime location on Passeig de Gràcia with direct access to luxury shopping
Rooftop terrace and pool with panoramic Barcelona city views
Full-service spa with comprehensive wellness treatments
Classic European elegance with modern luxury amenities
cons: Busy street location may have urban noise
